channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Caso Milton Leite: Polícia Civil afasta delegados e diretor de cadeia
item.description: São Paulo Police Civil temporarily removed prison officers and three investigators suspected of favoring former councilman Milton Leite and the PCC during a Public Ministry operation. The SSP confirmed the measure and opened an inquiry to ensure the investigation proceeds without interference.

item.title: Richarlison pede ajuda à PF ao voltar a dizer que Flávio “tomou” ilha
item.description: Striker Richarlison accuses Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and lawyer Willer Tomaz of irregularly seizing possession of an island in Angra dos Reis worth R$ 10 million without payment. The player requested a Federal Police investigation and claimed the judiciary failed by granting possession within 24 hours.

item.title: MPF cobra polícias de AL sobre prisão de porteiro em panelaço contra Flávio
item.description: The Federal Public Ministry of Alagoas requested explanations from the Civil and Military Police regarding the arrest of a doorman during a panelaço against Flávio Bolsonaro in Maceió. The investigation aims to clarify the circumstances of the approach and possible electoral repercussions of the case.

item.title: Quem é Roberta Luchsinger e por que a entrevista dela apavora Lula
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a 41-year-old lobbyist, will give an interview to CNN Brasil, causing concern in Lula's campaign over potential revelations about corruption involving the petista government and his son Fábio Luís. She has faced criticism for alleged ties to the president and suspicious lobbying activities at the Planalto.

item.title: TSE mantém no ar capa de VEJA com denúncias de Vorcaro contra Lula, depois de perícia
item.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court (TSE) decided to keep alive the cover story by magazine VEJA in which banker Daniel Vorcaro accuses President Lula of involvement in a corruption scheme involving pension funds from state-owned companies. The ruling was issued by Minister Nunes Marques after forensic analysis, considering the report does not present falsehood or serious decontextualization. The report includes audio recordings where Vorcaro admits having paid $30 million to fund an Oliver Stone film about Lula and offered $1 billion to government allies to access pension funds.

item.title: STJ exonera servidor suspeito de vazar decisões a advogado amigo de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The STJ dismissed IT server Humberto Pradera following an investigation into leaks of court decisions to lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Tomaz denies any wrongdoing, but the case is under review by the Attorney General's Office.

item.title: Flávio percorre orla de Salvador entre gritos de ‘volta Bolsonaro’ e provocações de petistas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential hopeful, held a rally along Salvador's waterfront with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Mayor Bruno Reis (União Brasil). Supporters chanted "Bolsonaro return" while Lula (PT) backers taunted from apartment buildings. Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) responded with attacks on Lula, as banners framed the conflict as "patriots vs communists".

item.title: Eleições: coligação de Lula aciona ONU, PGE e PF contra atuação da Meta
item.description: The 'Brasil Pronto pra Mais' coalition supporting Lula's reelection filed complaints with the UN, PGE, and PF over Meta's role in the 2026 elections, citing alleged technical failures and bias. The campaign raises concerns about content restrictions on Lula and possible illegal funding for Flávio Bolsonaro. Meta denies favoritism and attributes issues to technical glitches.

item.title: Filha de FHC, advogados e ex-ministros assinam carta de apoio à reeleição de Lula
item.description: Family members of FHC, former ministers and intellectuals have signed a letter supporting Lula's re-election, warning of risks to democracy in case of a victory by Flávio Bolsonaro. The document brings together 15 names and highlights the defense of institutional balance and social rights.

item.title: Atos de rua por Lula misturam fã-clubes, nativos digitais e mobilização fora de partidos
item.description: Street demonstrations organized by fan clubs and digital natives supported Lula in the runoff, surprising the political scenario. The spontaneous mobilization took place after a considered dull first round and changed the perception of the presidential dispute.

item.title: Após derrota no primeiro turno, Paes se engaja em campanha de Lula no Rio
item.description: Eduardo Paes, defeated in the race for Rio's governorship, joins Lula's campaign in the second round, focusing on poor communities and conservative voters in the West Zone. He advocates avoiding ideological agendas and attacks on evangelicals, prioritizing dialogue and concrete deliveries to reduce Flávio Bolsonaro's lead in the state.

item.title: Rodolfo Borges na Crusoé: O rebaixamento anunciado
item.description: Corinthians, after eight consecutive losses, sits in the relegation zone of the 2026 Brasileirão with mounting pressure on manager Rodolfo Borges. Despite the dire situation, the club aims to avoid relegation in the upcoming round, though criticism grows over the coaching and board decisions.

item.title: Flávio exalta Jair Bolsonaro em carreata no Espírito Santo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro took part in a parade in Espírito Santo alongside Tarcísio de Freitas and Nikolas Ferreira, where he praised Jair Bolsonaro and highlighted millions of supporters. The event strengthens alliances for the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Revista divulga laudo para atestar autenticidade de áudio com Vorcaro
item.description: Technical report confirms authenticity of Daniel Vorcaro's audio regarding alleged funding for a documentary involving President Lula. Federal Police stated Vorcaro did not present this content as a plea bargain proposal, which was rejected for insufficiency. The audio mentions payments to the Black Horse film linked to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro but specifies no values or evidence.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede ao STF passe livre no transporte interestadual durante segundo turno
item.description: Lula's campaign asks the STF to establish free interstate transportation during the election runoff, expanding the previous ruling that already guaranteed free municipal and intermunicipal transport.

item.title: STJ exonera servidor suspeito de vazar dados a advogado ligado a Flávio
item.description: The STJ fired an employee suspected of leaking confidential data to lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro. Federal police identified messages in which the employee shared information about cases and documents from the court.

item.title: Empresário do agro em MT doa R$ 2 milhões à campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Agribusiness entrepreneur Elói Vitório Marchett donated R$ 2 million to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, in two transfers of R$ 1 million each. Marchett operates in soy cultivation, seeds, transportation, storage and cattle ranching in Mato Grosso. He is the father-in-law of federal deputy Fábio Garcia.

item.title: TSE alerta para mudança de endereço de quase 5 mil seções eleitorais
item.description: The TSE reports that 4,864 polling stations had their voting locations changed between the first and second rounds, due to weather conditions and accessibility improvements. The second round takes place on October 25th, with ballots for president only and, in six states and the Federal District, for governor. Authorities recommend voters check their new polling location via the e-Título app or the TSE website before heading to vote.

item.title: Eleições de 2026 marcam a transformação digital da esquerda, diz Bites
item.description: The 2026 election highlights a digital transformation within the Brazilian left, with Lula leading in social media interactions (110.7 million) compared to Flávio Bolsonaro's 31.3 million. The Bites agency notes the rise of figures like André Janones and Ana Elisa, indicating a more decentralized left-wing strategy following the first round.

item.title: Renda, idade avançada e desalento afastam o eleitor das urnas
item.description: High voter abstention in the 2026 elections reflects challenges such as low income, advanced age, and political disengagement, with 21.1% of eligible voters not participating. Experts note these factors particularly impact low-income voters and youth, potentially harming candidates like Lula. The lack of representation in the three largest electoral colleges is also a major obstacle.

item.title: Favela e prédios contrastam em panelaço contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A video released on the evening of October 16, 2026 shows protests in residential buildings in Salvador during Flávio Bolsonaro's live interview with TV Globo, while a nearby favela remains silent. The action, called by federal deputy André Janones, replicated protests against Dilma Rousseff and mobilized Lula supporters across several capitals.

item.title: Padre Kelmon pede Pix para fazer campanha para Flávio: "Me patrocine"
item.description: Defeated candidate Padre Kelmon requested donations via social media to finance a campaign supporting Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid, aiming to mobilize religious leaders across several states. He stated he will cover expenses such as travel, meals, and promotion through contributions, reaffirming his commitment despite winning only 21,411 votes.

item.title: Ex-ministros de FHC e intelectuais fazem carta em apoio a Lula
item.description: Former FHC ministers and intellectuals issue a letter backing Lula's reelection, emphasizing democracy and socially just development. The statement criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro and frames the election as a choice transcending ideological differences.

item.title: TSE muda local de votação de 4.352 seções para o segundo turno; veja como consultar
item.description: The TSE changed voting locations for 4,352 sections in the second round of the 2026 elections, representing 0.87% of the national total, due to emergency repairs, accessibility improvements, and weather damage. Voters should check their new polling places in advance through the e-Título app or TSE website to avoid unnecessary trips on October 25th.

item.title: “Globo sabe que errou”, diz Edinho sobre almoço com Flávio
item.description: Edinho Silva, PT chairman, criticized Globo's disparate treatment of President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro following a lunch meeting between the broadcaster's executives and the PL candidate. Globo denied any irregularities, stating the meeting was a routine institutional visit. Lula declared that TV Globo is under suspicion regarding his re-election bid.

item.title: Novo diz que campanha de Lula faz ‘showmícios’ e pede produção de provas ao TSE
item.description: The Novo Party filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting evidence production regarding alleged 'showmícios' promoted by Lula's campaign, claiming that artistic performances at rallies are prohibited by law. The party also requested the suspension of events in Copacabana, Salvador, and Porto Alegre, alleging irregularities in electoral funding and propaganda.

item.title: Ratinho faz propaganda eleitoral com Flávio; assista
item.description: Ratinho featured in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign ad, appealing to the general audience while pledging to preserve social programs. The senator announced an 'Einstein standard' for public health and called supporters to a rally in São Paulo.

item.title: Bites vê Janones no centro da virada e Exército de Lula veste amarelo
item.description: André Janones led a massive mobilization on Instagram, using the Brazilian national team jersey as a symbol of national unity and indirect pressure against President Lula's government, with the hashtag #OVerdeAmareloENosso trending. Supported by conservative figures and civil society, Janones surpassed traditional influencers in social media engagement, indicating a new communication strategy from the right-wing base. The episode reflects Brazil's polarization and the strategic use of social media to amplify political influence.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio lançam o site “Flaviômetro” no 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's allies launched the 'Flaviometer' website to track digital support from right-wing politicians in the runoff. The tool identifies who has already endorsed the senator and publicly pressures those who are absent, such as Michelle Bolsonaro. The goal is to pressure the conservative base to unify support against Lula.

item.title: Com 6x1, Alcolumbre e Lula deixam "futricas" para trás por reeleições
item.description: Lula and Alcolumbre are reapproaching due to mutual dependence for reelection, with Alcolumbre approving the 6x1 workweek reduction supporting Lula's campaign. The relationship faced tensions, including the rejection of a Supreme Court nomination, but is now strengthening for 2026.

item.title: STJ abre investigação e exonera servidor suspeito de vazar minutas de decisões a advogado amigo de Flávio
item.description: The STJ opened an investigation and fired Humberto Fontoura Pradera, a technology employee suspected of leaking case summaries to lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro. Message exchanges, documented in a PF spreadsheet, suggest sharing judicial process information. The case is under review by the PGR.

item.title: Os detalhes da perícia que comprova a autenticidade do áudio de Vorcaro sobre Lula
item.description: VEJA published an audio of Vorcaro with corruption allegations involving Lula, whose authenticity was confirmed by forensic analysis. The former banker claims he paid bribes for access to state pension funds, with meetings involving Alexandre Padilha and a plea deal proposal.

item.title: Flávio promete “Brasil de amor” e fala em governar para quem fez o “L”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro delivered a speech in Vitória (ES) promising a 'Brazil of love,' extending governance beyond Lula's supporters, and condemning hate. During the event, he danced to the song 'petista disfarçado', reinforcing a polarizing rhetoric. The campaign featured appearances by PL figures and the São Paulo state government.

item.title: Mais de 4 mil eleitores tiveram locais votação alterados
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) changed the voting location for 4,352 electoral sections in the second round of the 2026 elections, representing 0.87% of the national total. Changes occurred due to renovations, accessibility improvements, and damage from adverse weather conditions, especially in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and Bahia. The TSE recommends voters check their new section addresses via the e-título app or TSE portal.

item.title: Ministério da Justiça reforça artilharia contra Meta por atuação na eleição
item.description: The Ministry of Justice suggested a public civil action against Meta over suspected favoring of Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 election. The Federal Public Ministry investigates content moderation practices following thousands of removal reports during the electoral period.

item.title: Lula e Flávio vão em desespero rumo ao desempate
item.description: Polls show Lula and Flávio D'Ávila tied heading into the final stretch of the runoff campaign, leaving the PT candidate in a delicate position despite winning the first round. The race remains tense and volatile.

item.title: Pesquisa Ipespe: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 48% das intenções de voto contra Lula, que marca 46% no segundo turno
item.description: A new Ipespe poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 48% of voting intentions versus 46% for Lula in the second round, within the margin of error. Lula rolled out benefits for small business owners and university students, while Flávio Bolsonaro seeks broader backing from allied parties.

item.title: A estratégia de Lula no segundo turno que chamou atenção de jornal britânico
item.description: The Financial Times highlights Lula's shift in campaign strategy for the runoff, using 'selfie videos' and young influencers as a new electoral tool. The report also mentions accusations of Meta interference, denied by the company, and points to challenges such as cost of living, debts, and security, despite economic growth.

item.title: Flávio perde votos quando eleitor o imagina governando
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro struggles to gain support from voters who view him as a threat to democracy, losing votes when they imagine his government. His campaign needs to avoid debates about constitutional changes and the legacy of his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula está animado para “confronto” com Flávio, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: President Lula da Silva is preparing for a direct debate against senator Flávio Bolsonaro on Sunday (18). The PT accuses the PL candidate of corruption and seeks a confrontation over R$250 billion cuts in public policies. Meanwhile, polls show a technical tie between the two candidates.

item.title: Na TV, Flávio Bolsonaro diz ser alvo de fake news, e Lula fala às mulheres
item.description: On Saturday's election broadcast, Flavio Bolsonaro denied alleged fake news about cuts to social policies such as Bolsa Família and SUS, while Lula criticized the lack of respect for female voters and emphasized the importance of women in politics. Both candidates called on supporters for demonstrations on Sunday, ahead of the runoff vote on October 25th.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cobra Meta no TSE e também se diz prejudicado após restrições contra Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a lawsuit at the TSE accusing Meta of failing to curb the spread of negative ads against his candidacy, which is banned under electoral law. He also claimed to be harmed by restrictions imposed on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign.

item.title: A munição de Lula para o debate na Band
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's Globo interview shaped Lula's strategy for the Band debate, potentially adopting a confrontational tone. The Lula campaign adjusted its messaging based on statements from the Senate candidate.

item.title: Se eleito, Flávio subirá rampa do Planalto com Bolsonaro, diz Nikolas
item.description: At a campaign event in Vitória (ES), federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira claimed that Flávio Bolsonaro will ascend the Palácio do Planalto ramp alongside his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio was joined by figures such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Lorenzo Pazolini, and has additional campaign events scheduled for the same day in Salvador (BA).

item.title: Datafolha: redução da maioridade penal tem apoio de 89% dos eleitores de Flávio e 70% dos de Lula
item.description: A Datafolha survey reveals that 89% of Flávio Bolsonaro's voters and 70% of Lula's supporters back lowering the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16. Voting intentions for the 2026 runoff show Flávio at 47% and Lula at 45%.

item.title: TSE manda Meta garantir isonomia a campanhas depois de falha em IA
item.description: TSE minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze banned Meta from restricting electoral publications of presidential candidates, ensuring equal treatment in campaigns. The decision responds to a PT lawsuit alleging AI failures that limited content about Lula while allowing it for Flávio Bolsonaro. The company faces a daily fine of R$500,000 for non-compliance.

item.title: Edinho Silva defende votar PEC da Segurança e debater maioridade depois
item.description: Edinho Silva, national president of the PT, advocated for the approval of the Public Security Constitutional Amendment and the creation of the Ministry of Public Security, emphasizing greater coordination among government branches to combat organized crime. He stated that the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility should be discussed later, and criticized proposals against ammunition tracking, such as the one defended by Flávio Bolsonaro, for benefiting organized crime.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que Lula quer ‘confronto direto’ e tentará ‘desmascarar’ Flávio em debate
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva stated that Lula will seek direct confrontation with Flávio Bolsonaro in the Band debate to expose lies and highlight political project differences. Lula's strategy focuses on social proposals and criticism of Flávio's austerity measures, with preparation led by Sidônio Palmeira and support from journalist Olga Curado.

item.title: Novo vai ao TSE para tentar barrar shows de apoio a Lula
item.description: The Novo Party filed a lawsuit with the TSE to block the Ato Musical pela Democracia, featuring performances by Caetano Veloso, Djavan and other artists supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The motion claims the events constitute illegal electoral campaigns and demands details on funding, contracts and payments. The party also requested documents on the event organization and set a potential fine of R$ 100,000 for non-compliance.

item.title: Mais de 4 mil seções eleitorais tiveram locais de votação alterados
item.description: The TSE changed voting locations for 4,352 electoral sections in the second round, representing 0.87% of the country's sections. Changes occurred due to renovations, accessibility improvements, and damage from heavy rains. Voters should verify if their sections changed location via the e-título app or TSE portal.
